notes: Kazakhstan: first run, 15 entries (8 marked 24 h). Official bodies (gov.kz regional veterinary departments for Almaty region and Karaganda) list only reception contacts - no animal duty rota or poison line found. The Almaty municipal ambulance (+7 708 595 64 04, 109) is round-the-clock but for stray animals only and is documented only in sources, not as an entry. Most clinic sites are not found by the search tool; 24 h lists on weproject.media, zoon.kz, 2gis, 103.kz are aggregators and were used only as leads. Could not open: veravet.kz (redirect loop; Vera clinics in Almaty listed 24 h only by aggregators), dogmavetclinic.kz (Astana/Kostanay, client error), zoovita.kz (robots), vetklinika-ashurkova.kz (robots; Astana Keregetas 48 listed 24 h only by a media article), simba.vet (is an Irkutsk clinic, unrelated), medvet.kz / Dog Premium / U Lukomorya / Shans Almaty / VetStar / Zoovita Almaty (no own page reachable; MedVet, VetStar and others only on 2gis/directories). Still to do: Shymkent, Aktobe, Taraz, Oskemen, Kostanay, Semey, Kokshetau, Aktau, Oral, Kyzylorda, Turkestan (no own clinic site found yet), Aqtaban Astana, Nika Astana, Almaty clinics above, KazNAU university clinic, Karaganda Medical/agrarian clinics. Follow-up run 2026-11-12: 3 entries added (Aibolit Kostanay, ZooDoctor Oral, ZooPomoshch Almaty; none 24 h; 18 entries in total, 8 x 24 h). The search tool returned almost only aggregators (2gis, zoon, 103.kz, spravker, mestam), so own sites were not found for Shymkent (about 30 clinics only on directories, e.g. Hatiko, ZooVetService, VetaClinic, Kot i Pes), Aktobe (only an aktobe.city directory card), Taraz, Semey (only the regional veterinary lab on Facebook), Kokshetau, Aktau (Doctor-Vet only on directories/Instagram), Kyzylorda, Turkestan. Unreachable: tanba.kezekte.kz official registry of veterinary organisations (robots_disallowed), zoovita.kz (Oskemen/East Kazakhstan centre, robots_disallowed), lahd.b2b.ivest.kz (Druzhok Aktobe, client error), kaznaru.edu.kz department page (client error; KazNAU university clinic not confirmed), astana-online.kz, vet-apteka.satu.kz (redirect), gov.kz Shymkent (client error), petfinder.kz, spr.kz, inshymkent.kz, city04.kz, inaktau.kz (client errors). faunavko.kz and rvl.kz (Oskemen) were only seen in a directory summary and could not be fetched (not in provenance set). Aqtaban Astana: no own website found, only directories. Nika: nika.vet is a Barnaul (Russia) clinic, unrelated; Nika Astana (Zheltoksan 24/1) has no own page found. VetLab Oskemen: only an Abay-region lab Facebook page (not used). Left: all of the above cities, KazNAU clinic, Aqtaban, Nika Astana, Oskemen (Fauna, Zoovita) - skipped as unreachable twice. Note: the CVM branch page https://vetklinika.kz/locations/cvm-na-abaja/ states 'Режим работы: круглосуточно' at Mamyr-4 111d (same as existing CVM Mamyr-4 entry).
